problem_evidence: Public product/docs evidence shows a broad Indian-language API surface covering speech, translation, TTS, LLM, and document workflows; this supports a real product problem but not paid demand.
The API pricing page makes usage units explicit and includes rate-limit/support upgrades, indicating a commercial developer platform rather than a purely research product.
Doc AI documentation names concrete back-office workflows such as KYC, invoices, claims, land deeds, healthcare intake, and resumes; these are candidate pain areas to validate with buyers.
Inference: the strongest near-term wedge is not generic chat, but multilingual document and voice workflows where local language coverage and deployment constraints matter.

positioning.statement: For India-focused product and operations teams that need multilingual voice or document automation, Sarvam AI is the Indian-language AI platform that combines specialized models, a unified API surface, and production-oriented support so teams can launch localized workflows without stitching together multiple providers.
positioning.claim_to_test: Qualified teams will choose Sarvam for a paid production pilot when it reduces integration complexity or improves acceptance-test accuracy versus their current cloud or open-model stack.

go_to_market.primary_channel: targeted founder-led technical sales to high-volume BFSI/govtech/customer-support teams, paired with a benchmark-driven pilot
go_to_market.secondary_channel: systems integrators, cloud partners, and developer-led cookbook/benchmark content
go_to_market.motion: product-led evaluation into paid usage pilot, then enterprise expansion for rate limits, support, security, and deployment
go_to_market.message: Evaluate your real Indian-language documents/audio against Sarvam and get to a production decision with transparent usage economics and a single integration surface.
go_to_market.initial_offer: 14-day or fixed-credit production pilot with one workflow, acceptance metrics, solution-engineer review, and a conversion path to Pro/Business credits or enterprise terms
funnel_assumptions: 50 named accounts contacted in first 30 days
stop_conditions: Fewer than 3 qualified evaluations from 50 targeted accounts: change vertical or trigger
Pilot accuracy/latency does not beat incumbent on agreed dataset: narrow use case or improve model/product
No paid conversion after 4 completed pilots: revisit buyer, packaging, or proof of ROI
Support burden exceeds gross profit on pilots: tighten scope and introduce paid implementation

roadmap.hypothesis: BFSI/govtech document or voice workflows have urgent Indian-language pain and budget.
roadmap.action: Interview 10 target buyers and rank workflows by volume, urgency, and incumbent dissatisfaction.
roadmap.deliverable: ICP brief and ranked use-case scorecard
roadmap.decision_rule: If fewer than 3 buyers name a near-term production trigger, change vertical or trigger.

roadmap.hypothesis: Sarvam can win on quality or workflow simplicity on real Indian-language data.
roadmap.action: Collect consented sample documents/audio and benchmark Sarvam against incumbent/open alternative.
roadmap.metric: At least 100 documents or 10 hours audio across target languages
roadmap.decision_rule: Continue only if one workflow shows a measurable win or materially lower integration cost.

roadmap.hypothesis: A fixed-credit, fixed-scope pilot will convert evaluation into paid production intent.
roadmap.action: Create pilot scope, acceptance criteria, pricing page/one-pager, and security FAQ.
roadmap.decision_rule: If buyers reject paid conversion criteria, revise value metric and proof of ROI.

roadmap.hypothesis: Targeted technical outreach beats broad awareness for the first wedge.
roadmap.action: Contact 50 named accounts through founder-led outreach, partners, and relevant communities.
roadmap.decision_rule: If reply/qualification is weak, switch trigger or partner source before adding spend.

roadmap.hypothesis: The winning workflow can reach production acceptance within 2 weeks.
roadmap.action: Launch 4 scoped pilots with weekly technical and buyer reviews.
roadmap.decision_rule: Stop pilots with no data owner, acceptance metric, or production sponsor.

roadmap.hypothesis: Usage revenue covers variable inference and support costs at the proposed package.
roadmap.action: Instrument usage, infra cost, support hours, and outcome value by account.
roadmap.deliverable: Account-level gross-margin sheet and pricing readout
roadmap.metric: Cost and usage captured for all active pilots
roadmap.decision_rule: Do not scale a use case with negative contribution after support cost.

roadmap.hypothesis: Buyers pay for production confidence, rate limits, and supportÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Ânot raw model access alone.
roadmap.action: Test Pro/Business credit packages, annual discount, and paid implementation boundary.
roadmap.metric: At least 2 pricing conversations with concrete objections and one verbal commit
roadmap.decision_rule: Keep only packaging with clear upgrade trigger and acceptable margin hypothesis.

roadmap.hypothesis: A successful pilot can convert to recurring usage within 30 days.
roadmap.action: Close pilots with production plan, contract path, usage forecast, and support scope.
roadmap.deliverable: Paid production contracts or documented loss reasons
roadmap.metric: 1-2 paid conversions; 90-day usage forecast per account
roadmap.decision_rule: If zero conversions after 4 completed pilots, change ICP, offer, or proofÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Ânot just lead volume.

roadmap.hypothesis: A standard benchmark and pilot playbook can reduce sales/implementation effort.
roadmap.action: Document qualification, benchmark, security, pricing, and handoff steps; recruit one channel partner.
roadmap.metric: Second pilot delivered with 25% less internal effort
roadmap.decision_rule: Scale the channel only if partner-sourced opportunity reaches qualification threshold.

roadmap.hypothesis: The winning wedge has enough conversion, margin, retention signal, and reachable pipeline to justify investment.
roadmap.action: Review funnel, usage gross profit, support load, churn signals, and model quality by segment.
roadmap.metric: Paid conversion, contribution margin, pipeline coverage, and pilot effort meet thresholds
roadmap.decision_rule: Scale only if contribution is positive and at least one repeatable acquisition path is evidenced.
